rationale: The bug is the condition `len(user_entry) <= 1`. The contract requires logging only usernames of exactly one character, which would be `len(user_entry) == 1`. The implemented condition incorrectly also logs empty strings (`len == 0`) because `0 <= 1`. This is a missing edge case bug where the logic fails on the degenerate empty string input, while the primary return value (the boolean check for length >= 3) remains correct across all inputs.
